name: Grind Enchantments
summary: Adds grindstone features: strip enchantments from an item onto a book while keeping the item, and move enchantments between books. Both cost experience levels, and the pack's configuration enables both.

mechanics.title: Disenchant to book
mechanics.description: Put an enchanted item and a plain book into the grindstone to get an enchanted book with the item's enchantments; the item is returned unenchanted. Pack config: enabled, enchanted item is not consumed (it comes back disenchanted), all enchantments are taken.

mechanics.title: Move enchantments between books
mechanics.description: Put an enchanted book in the top slot and another book (empty or enchanted) in the bottom slot; the first enchantment of the top book is moved onto the other book. Useful for splitting books with mixed enchantments.

mechanics.title: XP cost
mechanics.description: Both operations cost levels; the cost is shown in the grindstone UI (show_enchantment_cost true). Disenchant cost is derived from enchantment power (offset 8, factor 0.3); moving cost scales with levels, with treasure enchantments weighted more. Exact in-game numbers should be verified.

mechanics.title: Filters
mechanics.description: Pack config has no item or enchantment restrictions; cursed enchantments are allowed. The 'reset repair cost' feature (diamond catalyst) is disabled.

vanilla_changes.change: Grindstone gains the disenchant-to-book and move-enchantment operations (costs XP levels).

getting_started: Place an enchanted tool and a book in a grindstone.
editor_notes: Cost formula summary is an interpretation of the JSON cost functions; verify in-game. Mod supports Tax Free Levels, which is in the pack.
